title: Stability Sentinel playbook and sprint index
content:
Purpose:
This doc is a compact, tactical playbook + sprint index used by Product Ops to gate feature rollouts that have non-trivial stability risk (eg: new batching path, quantization profile changes, network routing updates). The goal: give PMs, EngOps, SRE, and Sales a single page to check readiness signals, owners, and quick mitigations during canary and staged ramps.

Quick summary (TL;DR):
- Primary SLOs tracked: 99th P99 latency, p95 tail latency, token cost variance, error rate (5xx + model-fallbacks).
- Canary window: 72 hours for initial telemetry; extended to 7 days for stateful/long-tail UXs.
- Go/no-go signals: automatic block if error rate > 0.5% sustained for 30m or P99 > target + 40%.
- Primary contacts: Eng on-call (Liam), Product Ops lead (Aisha), SRE lead (Sofia).

KPI tracker (snapshot format for sprintboard ingestion):
- Metric: P99 latency (ms) | Baseline: 210ms | Canary target: <= 280ms | Current canary: 235ms | Owner: eng-serving-runtime
- Metric: Request error rate (%) | Baseline: 0.12% | Canary threshold: 0.5% | Current canary: 0.07% | Owner: eng-sre
- Metric: Token burn delta (%) | Baseline: 0% | Red threshold: +15% | Current: +3% | Owner: product-hosted-api
- Metric: Cold-starts / 1k req | Baseline: 2.1 | Canary alert: >6 | Current: 1.8 | Owner: infra
- Metric: Eval pass rate (regression tests on golden prompts) | Baseline: 98% | Minimum: 95% | Current: 96% | Owner: applied-ml

Rollout phases & signals (condensed):
1) Internal smoke (team-only) – 2 hours
   - checklist: smoke tests green (runbook smoke v1), no SRE alerts, dev telemetry sanity.
   - thumbs: Eng owner explicit + sign-off in Slack #product-ops-stability
2) Canary (1-3% traffic) – 72h window
   - automated gates (Prometheus + alert rules); must pass KPI tracker above.
   - manual checkpoint at 24h and 72h for Exec/PM review (notes in Jira).
3) Phased ramp (10%, 30%, 60%) – each phase 24–48h
   - canary-runbook checklist repeated; ops-run threshold is stricter during 30->60.
4) General availability (GA) – monitor 14 days for tail regressions

Go/no-go gating matrix (short):
- Block immediately if: error rate > 0.5% sustained 30m OR surge in model-fallbacks > 2x baseline OR P99 > baseline * 1.4 for 30m.
- Pause ramp if: token burn > +10% for 1h OR sudden increase in cold-starts (x3 baseline).
- Continue if: all KPIs within green and no new persistent customer complaints.

Owner responsibilities (one-liners):
- Eng (serving-runtime): ensure new kernel runs in perf harness; provide golden comparison outputs.
- SRE/infra: enable temporary autoscaler changes; monitor cold-start heatmap.
- Product Ops: coordinate checkpoints, update Jira/Confluence, notify sales/CS for customer comms.
- Applied ML: run evals against regression prompt set and sign off quality threshold.

Checklist (copyable into sprint ticket):
- [ ] Smoke tests (dev) executed and green (link smoke run).
- [ ] Golden evals run, pass >=95% acceptance on regression set.
- [ ] Canary infra configured, routes verified in staging, canary percent set.
- [ ] Dashboards created and pinned (latency, errors, token-burn, fallbacks).
- [ ] Pager thresholds staged and verified; routing fallback policy defined.
- [ ] CS and Sales notified of canary start (template message pre-approved).
- [ ] Rollback plan documented (how to revert model variant, routing rule, or quantization profile).
- [ ] Communication plan for customers and status page updates drafted.

Rollback primitive steps (quick):
1) Re-route canary traffic to previous model variant in routing layer (10s ops action).
2) If regression persists, scale down new pool and enable dedicated fallback model.
3) Apply hotfix config to disable new batching path (if applicable) and rebuild canary nodes.
4) Post-mortem owner assigned within 24h if rollback triggered.

Risks and mitigations (bullet):
- Risk: Hidden quality drift not detected by regression set.
  Mitigation: Expand golden set with customer-specific prompts for first 7 days; enable manual sampling.
- Risk: Cost spike from token-burn delta.
  Mitigation: Emergency throttle policy; cost alert to finance + product-ops.
- Risk: Cross-region routing causing cache misses.
  Mitigation: Region-aware canary (start single region), KV-prefill on canary nodes.

Sprint index (short): which sprints to check this doc and owners
- Sprint N (this week): finalize runbook + add dashboard widgets (owner: Aisha)
- Sprint N+1: exec dry-run + full canary (owner: Liam)
- Sprint N+2: phased ramp and GA decision (owner: Sofia)

Open questions / outstanding items (notes to self):
- Need clarity on who signs off GA for enterprise customers with dedicated contracts — is it Sales Ops or Product? (action: @Priya to confirm)
- Can we automate the 24h manual checkpoint summary into a Confluence comment via webhook? (todo: engineers to estimate)
- Is the token-burn alert appropriately mapped to finance ledger id? (linked -> PRODOPS-482)

Handy links and playbook snippets: (paste into tickets)
- Canary start command (infra-runbook): infra run canary --percent=1 --tag=stability-2025-01
- Slack status template: "Canary for [feature] started. 1% traffic. Primary contacts: Aisha, Liam, Sofia. Will report 24h/72h."
- Post-mortem template path: Confluence > Playbooks > Stability > Postmortem-template

Notes to reviewers (informal):
- This is intentionally terse — we want a doc PMs actually check before flipping the switch. Please comment with any additional automated gates you think are essential.
- If you are a sales/CS reviewer: confirm the customer comms snippet covers SSO/integration specifics for enterprise accounts.

-- end --

(rough / living doc — expect changes as we iterate the automation around the gates)
